description: Drive a local ComfyUI render server from the shell, with a durable record of every run the server itself forgets.

tools.name: history_get
tools.description: Full record for one prompt: status (status_str, completed), the messages array carrying execution_start / execution_success / execution_error timestamps in milliseconds, and the outputs map. The timestamp delta is the ONLY honest source of per-prompt duration — scraping 'Prompt executed in N seconds' from the server log returns a stale line when the current run has not finished, and scraping an s/it progress bar returns a transient intra-run sample, not a rate. Required: prompt_id.

params.name: prompt_id
params.description: The prompt_id returned by prompt submit.

tools.name: history_list
tools.description: Recent prompt history, newest last. Optional: max_items.

params.name: max_items
params.description: Cap the number of returned records.

tools.name: objectinfo_all
tools.description: Every registered node class and its input schema.

tools.name: objectinfo_get
tools.description: Schema for one node class. Loader COMBO options live at index 1 of the input tuple as {'options' -> [...]}, NOT at index 0 — index 0 is the type string. An EMPTY options list means the model CLASS is unregistered (missing extra_model_paths.yaml key), not that the file is missing. Required: class_type.

params.name: class_type
params.description: Node class name, e.g. VAELoader or UNETLoader.

tools.name: prompt_submit
tools.description: Queue an API-format graph. Returns {prompt_id, number, node_errors} on success. On validation failure returns HTTP 400 with an error object plus a node_errors map keyed by node id — that detail is the whole diagnostic and must be surfaced verbatim, never summarised.

tools.name: queue_get
tools.description: Returns {queue_running, queue_pending}. A non-empty queue_running with an idle GPU means the job is in a non-sampling stage (VAE decode, video assembly), not stalled.

tools.name: queue_interrupt
tools.description: Interrupt the currently executing prompt. Does not clear pending items.

tools.name: system_stats
tools.description: ComfyUI version, python version, and per-device vram_total / vram_free. Device ordering here is torch ordering, which can be the INVERSE of nvidia-smi ordering — trust this endpoint for cuda:N identity, not nvidia-smi index.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload an image into ComfyUI's input dir. LoadImage takes a FILENAME inside that dir, never an absolute host path — passing an absolute path fails validation with 'Invalid image file'.

tools.name: userdata_get
tools.description: Read a user file. Workflow paths are URL-encoded, e.g. workflows%2Fname.json. Required: file.

tools.name: userdata_put
tools.description: Write a user file, creating parent dirs. Pass overwrite=true to replace. Required: file. Optional: overwrite.

tools.name: view_get
tools.description: Fetch an output file by filename/subfolder/type. Required: filename. Optional: subfolder, type.

novel_features.name: Idempotent submit lease
novel_features.description: Submitting a graph that is already rendering attaches to the running job instead of starting a second one.

novel_features.name: Model visibility triage
novel_features.description: Says why ComfyUI cannot see a model file, separating four causes that every other tool collapses into one.

novel_features.name: COMBO option values
novel_features.description: Prints the values a loader input will actually accept, reading both /object_info spec shapes.

novel_features.name: Guarded slot patching
novel_features.description: Applies overrides to a graph's inputs, refusing to write when a node no longer holds the class it did when the address was captured.

novel_features.name: Offline preflight
novel_features.description: Checks a graph against the cached node schema before submitting — unknown classes, missing required inputs, and COMBO values that are not members of the option list.

novel_features.name: Honest run timing
novel_features.description: Reports duration from the server's own execution timestamps, compared against the historical distribution for the same graph shape.

novel_features.name: Durable history ingest
novel_features.description: Copies the server's in-memory render history into the local store before a restart destroys it.

novel_features.name: Multi-arm experiments
novel_features.description: Runs a parameter sweep as one durable object, with failed arms recorded as first-class rows rather than gaps.

novel_features.name: Output provenance
novel_features.description: Given a produced file, reports the run, graph, experiment arm, timing, server identity, and staged input that made it.

novel_features.name: Stable input identity
novel_features.description: Stages a host file into ComfyUI's input directory and records its content hash, so archived runs stay reproducible.

novel_features.name: Attributed replay
novel_features.description: Re-runs a stored graph and reports a before/after delta including which server configuration each ran under.

novel_features.name: Probed output properties
novel_features.description: Lists produced files and, with --probe, fills in resolution, frame rate, duration, and whether audio is present.
